examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто.
examples.trans: Oh, that happens very often, Arkashenka.
We often meet in the park.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

многие из вас = many of you

examples.text: У многих из вас появились сомнения.
examples.trans: Many of you have begun to have doubts.
Many people think the same way.

meanings.note: 'закрывать глаза на' + accusative = to turn a blind eye to

examples.text: Я не буду закрывать на это глаза.
examples.trans: I'm not going to close my eyes to this.
We have nobody to fear here.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
